ns2:course.label: Structure and Function II
ns2:course.description: Teaches gross canine thoracic, abdominal, and cranial anatomy; gross avian anatomy; histology of the reproductive, digestive, and cardiac systems; reproductive, gastrointestinal, and cardiovascular physiology; neurobiology of the autonomic and special senses systems; and clinical correlations between these subjects and the clinical experiences of VM 601. Prerequisite: VCM 602 and good-standing in the veterinary professional curriculum or consent of instructor.
